scope: Targeted maintenance and watermark-index correction; no full suite or live canary

postgresql_lifecycle.counter_explanation: Bad row retained, healthy compact retained, old compact expired with its summary retained; expired recovery was deliberately exercised
postgresql_lifecycle.index_check: New watermark index eligible with transaction-local enable_seqscan=off on the tiny disposable dataset; not a performance benchmark
postgresql_lifecycle.cleanup: Disposable database, Git worktree and temporary test files removed; database absence and active production services verified

capacity.decision: Keep seven-day retention and producer disabled; do not credit deletion of legacy evidence or change other collectors' budgets
capacity.limitations: Conditional point-in-time allowance; core data, WAL, logs and future maintenance growth still need margin. Projection is from the earlier bounded storage experiment, not a measured live week.
